useCase: first field test: four-camera wiggle capture, handheld, battery bank in a pocket feeding the P4 over one long USB-C cable; P4 powers the four XIAOs through the JP1 harness

geometry.printOrientation: chassis lens-face down, face shell relief-up, door outer-face down; all three print with zero support material
geometry.p4Capture: four vertical posts press the threaded standoff tops; the foam-shimmed sliding rear door presses the glass perimeter through its full-length 45-degree dovetails. Tool-less: the door slides in from the far end and clicks over a detent; a firm pull opens it. The standoff threads stay free for the bench fit gauge.

hardware.m2Screws: 4 x M2x8-10 (XIAO clamps only; no screws to open or close the camera)
hardware.a2Inserts: 4 x A2 brass M2, OD 3.5 x L 4 (XIAO clamp bosses only; the rear door is tool-less)
hardware.quarterTwentyNuts: none supplied by the camera - no tripod mount, and the overhead light is held by its own two nuts reached down the light shaft
hardware.foam: 1.2 mm adhesive foam strip around the bezel window lip

geometry.wiring: P4 powered by USB-C standing off its component side into the open bay - no wall recess - with the cable turning down and out the bottom passage at X=40; four XIAOs wired to JP1 through the open rear; shutter switch to JP1 21 / GPIO28 with GND on JP1 6 or 16

printSettings: PETG, 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.20 mm layers, 2 perimeters, 20% gyroid, supports OFF, brim unnecessary (11562 mm^2 flat first layer); every part on its largest flat face as shipped
